limitations.statement: The 803-point shared S9 candidate grid does not cover the continuous interval tightly enough to prove the acceleration limit; the quintic supremum bound is conservative and exceeds the limit. FEASIBLE is asserted from the candidate-grid check plus all other checks, not as a strict continuous-time certificate for acceleration.
